annotation.authors_or_issuer: Group of Governmental Experts on Emerging Technologies in the Area of Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems, CCW (UNODA)
annotation.summary_en: Report of the 2019 CCW Group of Governmental Experts on lethal autonomous weapons systems. It records conclusions on IHL compliance, human responsibility and human-machine interaction, risk mitigation and dual use, restates guiding principles (Annex IV), and recommends continued GGE work in 2020–2021 without agreeing a binding instrument.
key_provisions_or_claims: IHL applies fully to all weapons systems including LAWS; obligations rest on humans and States, not machines.
Human responsibility and accountability must be retained across the weapon life cycle within a responsible chain of command.
New guiding principle on human-machine interaction ensuring IHL compliance.
Risk mitigation: testing, legal weapon reviews, training, rules of engagement, cybersecurity; dual-use R&D should not be restricted.
Recommends endorsing the guiding principles and continuing GGE work in 2020-2021; options discussed include a binding instrument or political declaration.
